title: NATS request/reply runner.folders.check.<host> (studio → the host's supervising runner)
description: From API 1.78 (contracts/README.md, Model folders). Core NATS request/reply on subject `runner.folders.check.<host>` (no queue group: the one runner of that host with RUNNER_PLUGINS on, as runner.plugins.key), bare JSON. Before PUT /v1/studio/admin/hosts/{host}/folders stores a list, studio asks what each path is on that host now: the runner expands `~`, never creates a folder, and answers per path in the request's order. Studio waits 5 s (no answer: 503 `<host> is offline`).

connected.description: the path is a folder now

writable.description: the runner can write it (false when not connected)

drive.description: the path is on a drive (under /Volumes/): it may be listed while unplugged
